The Committee also discovered that Rani Group directly employs only its managers, outsourcing all other staff from the Employee Placement Services of Namibia (EPSN) with zero oversight from onsite management on whether minimum wage, overtime, or legal working hours are actually being respected.

The committee was in the Northern regions to access and examine the compliance of companies with the Labour law.
